intent: A 2008-catalog gothic lolita gown for the classic blocky body: a crimson-bowed black headdress, a crimson-laced black bodice with a waist sash and back bow, bell sleeves and crimson gloves over a black tiered skirt with a cream lace band and crimson ruffle, reading from the high camera as a narrow crimson-banded top over a wide, stepped black bell.
